models_territory_territory: Territory is an Eloquent model in the real-estate-core module representing a geographic sales/lettings territory, with attribute casting, team scoping, and a team relationship.
models_valuation_valuation: Valuation is an Eloquent model in the real-estate-valuations module representing a property valuation record, supporting status transitions, attribute casting, and team scoping.
models_viewing_viewing: Viewing is an Eloquent model in the real-estate-viewings module representing a scheduled property viewing, supporting status transitions, attribute casting, and team scoping.
one_core_per_adapter_rule: Regola architetturale del modulo API secondo cui ogni pacchetto adapter (API, Filament, ecc.) dipende da un solo pacchetto core del dominio corrispondente.
one_to_one_adapter_rule: The one-to-one adapter rule requires each Real Estate domain module to have exactly one adapter package per presentation tier (API, Filament, Livewire).
pages_accountsecurity_accountsecurity: AccountSecurity is a Filament page in the sessions-devices-filament module that lets a user view and revoke their active sessions/devices.
pages_createmarketingcampaign: CreateMarketingCampaign is the Filament resource page for creating a new MarketingCampaign record in the real-estate-marketing-filament module.
pages_createonthemarketsync: CreateOnTheMarketSync is the Filament resource page for creating a new OnTheMarketSync record in the real-estate-onthemarket-filament module.
pages_createportalreport: CreatePortalReport is the Filament resource page for creating a new PortalReport record in the real-estate-portals-reporting-filament module.
pages_createrightmovesync: CreateRightmoveSync is the Filament resource page for creating a new RightmoveSync record in the real-estate-rightmove-filament module.
pages_createsalesprogression: CreateSalesProgression is the Filament resource page for creating a new SalesProgression record in the real-estate-sales-progression-filament module.
pages_createzooplasync: CreateZooplaSync is the Filament resource page for creating a new ZooplaSync record in the real-estate-zoopla-filament module.
pkg_liberusoftware_identity: liberusoftware/identity is a Composer package providing the core identity/authentication capability that other Liberu modules such as search and sessions-devices depend on.
planned_backlog_marker: 'planned' is a documentation marker used in the Real Estate core README to flag capabilities (e.g. lettings, property management) that are on the backlog but not yet implemented.
policies_lettingpolicy_lettingpolicy: LettingPolicy is a Laravel authorization policy in the real-estate-lettings module governing view, update, and delete access to Letting records.
policies_managementrecordpolicy_manageme: ManagementRecordPolicy is a Laravel authorization policy in the real-estate-property-management module governing view, update, and delete access to ManagementRecord records.
presentation_neutral_core: The Presentation-Neutral Core Package describes the real-estate-core module's design principle of keeping domain logic free of any specific UI framework, decoupled from Filament/Livewire presentation packages.
provider_neutral_domain: Provider-Neutral Domain, Replaceable Adapters describes the real-estate-marketing module's design where domain logic is independent of any specific presentation framework, with Filament and Livewire adapters as replaceable layers.
providers_telescopedashboardserviceprovi: TelescopeDashboardServiceProvider is a service provider in the observability module that registers Telescope's dashboard gate and hides sensitive request details.
re_theme_do_not_edit_installed_files: Aviso na documentação do tema real-estate-default alertando que os arquivos instalados em themes/ não devem ser editados diretamente, pois os repositórios de componentes são a fonte da verdade.
real_estate_core_api_module: Real Estate Core API is the API adapter package exposing the real-estate-core domain (agencies, branches, territories) over a team-scoped HTTP API.
real_estate_core_filament_module: Real Estate Core Filament is the Filament 5 presentation adapter package providing admin resources (e.g. Branch Resource) for the real-estate-core domain.
real_estate_delivery_order: The Real Estate delivery order defines the three-phase rollout plan for the Liberu Real Estate scope: core transaction chain first, then progression/portals, then lettings/management.
real_estate_instructions_api_module: Real Estate Instructions API is the API adapter package exposing the real-estate-instructions domain over a team-scoped, versioned OpenAPI HTTP interface.
real_estate_listings_livewire: Real Estate Listings Livewire is the Livewire 4 presentation adapter package providing a team-scoped list UI for the real-estate-listings domain.
real_estate_parties_api_module: Real Estate Parties API is the API adapter package exposing team-scoped real-estate-parties domain records under the /api/v1/real-estate namespace, documented via an OpenAPI v1 spec.
real_estate_project_scope: Real Estate project scope is documentation describing the overall set of core, API, Filament, and feature modules that make up the Liberu Real Estate product.
recovery_recoverycodehasher_recoverycode: RecoveryCodeHasher is a class in the two-factor-authentication module that hashes and verifies-and-consumes two-factor recovery codes.
registry_searcherregistry_searcherregist: SearcherRegistry is a class in the search module that registers and looks up available searcher implementations by type.
resources_branchresource: BranchResource.php is the Filament resource class in the real-estate-core-filament module for managing Branch records in the admin panel.
schema_error_envelope: The Error schema (message, code, errors) is an OpenAPI component in the real-estate-parties API spec defining the standard error response envelope shared across the real estate API specs.
schema_pagination_meta: The PaginationMeta schema is an OpenAPI component in the real-estate-parties API spec defining the pagination metadata shape shared across the real estate API specs.
seeders_databaseseeder: DatabaseSeeder.php is the root Laravel database seeder that orchestrates seeding of the application's base data.
seeders_teamseeder: TeamSeeder.php is a database seeder that creates initial Team records for the application.
seeders_userseeder: UserSeeder.php is a database seeder that creates initial User records for the application.
services_localsearchindexer_localsearchi: LocalSearchIndexer is a service class in the search module that indexes, removes, and flushes searchable records in the local search index.
services_thememanager_thememanager_activ: .activeCssEntry() is a method on ThemeManager in the theme-support module that resolves the active theme's CSS Vite entry.
services_thememanager_thememanager_first: .firstAsset() is a method on ThemeManager that returns the first available asset found while walking a theme's inheritance chain.
services_thememanager_thememanager_getth: .getThemeViewsPath() is a method on ThemeManager that resolves the filesystem path to a theme's Blade views directory.
services_thememanager_thememanager_regis: .registerThemePaths() is a method on ThemeManager that registers a theme's view and asset paths with Laravel's view finder.
